question: Should ClickClack permanently expose independent alignment controls for current-user messages and messages from all other participants?
rationale: Current behavior is not broken, and the patch adds a persistent user-facing appearance preference that existing repository policy does not mandate.

options.title: Approve independent controls
options.body: Adopt the two-setting model because it enables all four layouts while preserving the existing stored self-alignment behavior and current defaults.

options.title: Keep one alignment control
options.body: Decline the additional preference to retain a simpler appearance surface and close this PR without further code work.

recommendation.title: Approve independent controls
recommendation.body: Adopt the two-setting model because it enables all four layouts while preserving the existing stored self-alignment behavior and current defaults.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository-level product ownership is the best available signal for this permanent UI-policy choice.
